title: Fibonacci Sequence
code:
def fibonacci(n):
    a, b = 0, 1
    result = []
    for _ in range(n):
        result.append(a)
        a, b = b, a + b
    return result

print(fibonacci(10))
description: Generate the first N numbers of the Fibonacci sequence using iteration.

title: List Comprehension Examples
code:
squares = [x**2 for x in range(1, 11)]
print('Squares:', squares)

evens = [x for x in range(1, 21) if x % 2 == 0]
print('Evens:', evens)

flattened = [x for row in [[1,2],[3,4],[5,6]] for x in row]
print('Flattened:', flattened)

pairs = [(x, y) for x in range(3) for y in range(3) if x != y]
print('Pairs:', pairs)
description: Demonstrate Python list comprehensions with various patterns.

title: Quicksort
code:
def quicksort(arr):
    if len(arr) <= 1:
        return arr
    pivot = arr[len(arr) // 2]
    left = [x for x in arr if x < pivot]
    middle = [x for x in arr if x == pivot]
    right = [x for x in arr if x > pivot]
    return quicksort(left) + middle + quicksort(right)

data = [3, 6, 8, 10, 1, 2, 1]
print('Original:', data)
print('Sorted:', quicksort(data))
description: Implement quicksort using the list comprehension partition approach.
